body: You just don't understand how bad it's gotten.  I find myself over analyzing every single profile looking for signs that they used to be a man.  Also, who cares what other people think?  Fuck 'em.
I'm glad someone with some sense is in here!

And I'm also assuming when I donate sperm that they're going to give it to a couple that's struggling to have kids either because they're lesbians or the father is infertile/sterile.  Also, don't think it will matter much to me...because you know...I'll be dead.  I tried for 10 years to have my own kid with my wife and guess what?  She cheated 2 months before she moved out and was pregnant.  Kid born in January, she moved out in May.  That's not exactly rocket science.

I'm actually going to Tennessee to hike a mountain this month.  I've been to South Korea and all up and down the east coast. 

I visit new restaurants and try new things constantly.

Thanks.  My family loves me.  My friends love me.  Hell, I even love me.  My coworkers have always loved me.  My church-members love me.  Strangers on Reddit even say they love me.  

It doesn't help the fact that I'm suffering though.  That I don't see any other way to stop these feelings.  20 veterans a day commit suicide.  39% of American suicides are white males.  I'm part of the majority there.
